description: Which countries published NEW official economic numbers recently (inflation, central bank policy rate, unemployment, GDP growth), newest first. Detected daily by datacensus.org from national statistics offices, OECD, BIS and Eurostat. Use it to answer 'what changed today/this week' or 'did X publish new inflation data'.

country.description: Optional filter: country name or ISO3 code.

days.description: Look back this many days (default 7, max 120).

name: economic_data_releases
